parse.title: Void Knight equipment
parse.wikitext:
===Cost===
In total, the minimum amount of points needed to get a set that provides the damage bonus is 850 [[commendation points]]. This cost includes only one helmet, and excludes the [[Void knight mace|mace]] and [[Void Knight seal|seal]]. An additional 400 points are needed to upgrade the robe and top to [[Elite Void Knight equipment]], for a total of 1250.

Players will need an additional 400 points for the other two helmets; this brings the total points needed for a full set of elite void in every style to 1650.
